title: Status bar
brief: Status bar states: last request chip (sending, 2xx, 4xx, 5xx, failure), user config not loaded with file and line, config and workspace warnings, pending MCP approvals count opening the approvals view of bolt-v2/12-agent-approval.html, and several at once.

artboards.title: Inline chips
artboards.tradeoff: Each problem is named and one click from its fix; with everything at once the bar fills to about 900 px and the chips shift position as states come and go

artboards.title: Problems panel
artboards.tradeoff: A calm, stable bar that never grows past three chips and one place to read every issue; the file and line of a broken config sit one click away instead of on the bar

artboards.title: Strip for a broken config
artboards.tradeoff: A broken config cannot be missed and its fix is on screen; the strip costs 40 px of document height for as long as the file is broken, and compact chips rely on tooltips
